corpus.text: Databases organize information so it can be queried efficiently using structured query languages.
Indexes trade write cost for read speed by maintaining sorted structures for fast lookups.
Retrieval augmented generation grounds a language model in retrieved passages to reduce hallucination.
Vector search finds semantically similar text by comparing embedding vectors with cosine distance.
Chunking splits documents into smaller passages so relevant spans can be embedded and searched.
Caching search results reduces latency by serving repeated queries without recomputation.
The city museum opens at nine in the morning and closes at five in the evening.
A cold front will bring rain and strong winds along the coast through the weekend.
To bake sourdough, feed the starter, fold the dough, proof overnight, and bake in a hot oven.
The home team scored twice in the second half to win the championship final.
Direct flights between the two cities take about four hours and run twice daily.
The orchestra performed a symphony in four movements to a sold out concert hall.
